Dialogue[]

(Enter the gateway)
Changli: ...Interesting.
Changli: It reminds me of the Hongzhen in my memories.
(Approach the destination)
Changli: In that year, a peculiar incident occurred.
Changli: A parent lost their only child, and despite extensive searches around Mt. Firmament, no trace of the missing boy was discovered.
(Enter the gateway)
(Talk to the Illusia)
Uneasy Father: Please, help us find our son...
What was he doing before he disappeared?
Uneasy Father: We were having lunch together, just two days ago.
Uneasy Father: Later, I went up the mountain to fetch spring water. When I got back, he was gone...
Did your wife see him after you left home?
Uneasy Father: She said Jing was out playing with his friends... but he never came home.
Uneasy Father: I've been worried sick ever since, unable to eat or sleep... Jing, where are you now...
(Talk to the Illusia)
Desperate Mother: Jing, my poor boy... Please come back home...
Did Jing have any close friends?
Desperate Mother: Yes...
Did any of them happen to see him?
Desperate Mother: Jing had been increasingly withdrawn, preferring to stay home. He stopped playing with his friends.
Desperate Mother: But that day, he said he wanted to play with them. It seemed odd, so I ask those kids later, but none of them had seen Jing...
Desperate Mother: ... Oh, how can I go on without my Jing...
(Talk to the strange white cat)
(Fight the monsters)
Changli: Beyond the wolves' howls, there's another sound lurking in this storm.
Changli: Hehe, if you truly are the untamable beasts you claim to be, then why have you let yourself to be so easily at someone's disposal?
(Explore farther ahead)
(Dialogue from Xinyi's and Changli's past Illusias)
Xinyi: There's more to this case than meets the eye...
Changli: How about we start by investigating the missing person's home?
(Enter the gateway)
(Investigate the cabinet)
(You cautiously inspect the wooden cabinet and discover something strange.)
Changli: All of the boy's clothes since his infancy are neatly folded...
Changli: Except for... his pajamas.
Changli: Hmm... the board is set, but the final move is yet to be made.
(Further investigate)
(Talk to the strange white cat)
(Defeat the enemies)
(Dialogue from Xinyi's and Changli's past Illusias)
Xinyi: Now that we know who the real culprit is, it's time to act.
Changli: Madam, let's not be hasty. The time hasn't yet come.
(Enter the gateway)
(Defeat the enemies)
(Dialogue from Xinyi's and Changli's past Illusias)
Changli: Finding the culprit is simple. The real challenge is capturing them all at once.
Xinyi: Fully prepare and wait for the right moment—that's a wise strategy, Changli.
(Enter the gateway)
Uneasy Father: Did you find Jing?
Desperate Mother: Where is he? Please tell me...
You'll never see him again.
He's gone.
Uneasy Father: What?
Desperate Mother: No... my child... Who did this? Why would someone do this?
Stop pretending, Fractsidus.
You're the one who killed him.
Desperate Mother: W-what are you talking about? I don't understand...
Uneasy Father: How did you find out!?
I'm afraid you'll never know the answer.
(Defeat the Fractsidus)
(Explore farther ahead)
(Enter the gateway)
(Defeat the Fractsidus)
Changli: Ah, a defensive move?
Changli: Not bad, but the game is already finished.
(Suddenly, a thunderous sound erupts from the other side.)
(Talk to the Rover and the strange white cat)
Rover: You don't seem surprised to see me.
It's as I expected.
Rover: How did you know they killed Jing?
Mt. Firmament is always covered in snow.
Changli: No child would go in thin pajamas in such freezing conditions.
Rover: So you realized it was orchestrated by the Fractsidus...
Yes, it was Xinyi who solved this case.
The Fractsidus were lurking in Hongzhen, concealing their true identitites.
Rover: You know this is a dream, right?
Certainly.
Rover: Then why didn't you try to escape?
Changli: To win a game, you must first play it.
Changli: Besides... someone who knows they're dreaming is more dangerous, don't you think?
Rover: Making yourself part of the game... that's something you'd do.
Rover: I need you right now, Changli.
(Enter the gateway)
(Defeat the enemies)
Changli: Hehe, he's not the same as the one we faced before.
Rover: If they lost back then, they'll lose again today.
Changli: Don't worry. While my flames can't destroy this Somnoire, they're more than enough to handle these pests.
(Leave the Somnoire)
(Quest returns to When the Night Knocks)
